model.kiwi_retail.fct_orders.compiled_code:
select
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.store_id,
    o.region_code,
    o.channel,
    o.ordered_at,
    o.order_date,
    o.order_status,
    o.is_revenue_order,
    o.currency_code,
    o.fx_rate_to_nzd,
    o.discount_code,
    coalesce(t.line_count, 0) as line_count,
    coalesce(t.units, 0) as units,
    coalesce(t.items_subtotal, 0) as items_subtotal,
    o.shipping_fee,
    coalesce(t.items_subtotal, 0) + o.shipping_fee as order_total,
    round(cast(coalesce(t.items_subtotal, 0) + o.shipping_fee * case when o.currency_code = 'AUD' then 1.09 else 1 end as numeric(28,6)), 2) as order_total_nzd,
    coalesce(t.items_cost_nzd, 0) as items_cost_nzd,
    coalesce(p.paid_amount, 0) as paid_amount,
    coalesce(p.failed_attempts, 0) as failed_payment_attempts,
    coalesce(p.is_split_tender, false) as is_split_tender,
    coalesce(r.refund_amount, 0) as refund_amount,
    round(cast(coalesce(r.refund_amount, 0) * case when o.currency_code = 'AUD' then 1.09 else 1 end as numeric(28,6)), 2) as refund_amount_nzd,
    case
        when o.is_revenue_order
            then round(cast(coalesce(t.items_subtotal, 0) + o.shipping_fee - coalesce(r.refund_amount, 0) * case when o.currency_code = 'AUD' then 1.09 else 1 end as numeric(28,6)), 2)
        else 0
    end as net_revenue_nzd
from "warehouse"."intermediate"."int_orders__enriched" as o
left join "warehouse"."intermediate"."int_orders__item_totals" as t on o.order_id = t.order_id
left join "warehouse"."intermediate"."int_payments__by_order" as p on o.order_id = p.order_id
left join "warehouse"."intermediate"."int_refunds__by_order" as r on o.order_id = r.order_id

source.kiwi_retail.shop.orders.source_description: Kiwi Retail's commerce platform (POS for physical stores + the online shop), replicated nightly into the `raw` schema. Amounts are in the store's local currency (NZD or AUD).

source.kiwi_retail.shop.payments.description: One row per payment attempt. An order can have several rows: failed attempts and split tenders (gift card + card).
source.kiwi_retail.shop.payments.name: payments
